subject: general
question: In which of the following states is Sirohi / Shirui National Park located?
solution:
The correct answer is __Manipur.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sirohi National Park 

 
 
• ​It is located in Imphal, Manipur. (Indo-Myanmar border)
 
• It was established in 1982.
 
• Siroy Lily also called Shirui Lily or Lilium Macklinae (The state flower of Manipur) is a rare pinkish-white flower found only in the Sirohi Hill range that abounds in this area.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important National Park in Northeast State
